written_by: Claude (build owner), 2026-11-16, from layout B's schema and its code tables; reviewed against the original by row counts (portability check)
not_mapped: documents, notes, visits, encounters, claim denials, enrollment spans, concept_patient and the other semantic-layer tables layout B has no source for

views.patient: SELECT person_source_value AS patient_id, CASE gender_source_value WHEN 'FEMALE' THEN 'F' WHEN 'MALE' THEN 'M' END AS sex_reported, substr(birth_datetime, 1, 10) AS birth_date, race_source_value AS race, ethnicity_source_value AS ethnicity, zip, county, state FROM main.person
views.organization: SELECT care_site_source_value AS organization_id, care_site_name AS display_name, care_site_type AS organization_type FROM main.care_site
views.stay: SELECT p.patient_id, v.visit_start_date AS admit_date, v.visit_end_date AS discharge_date, v.visit_source_value AS type, s.care_site_source_value AS organization_id, CASE v.end_date_confirmed WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS discharge_known, CASE WHEN v.visit_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(julianday(v.visit_end_date) - julianday(v.visit_start_date) AS INTEGER) END AS los_days FROM main.visit_occurrence v JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) LEFT JOIN main.care_site s USING (care_site_id) WHERE v.feed = 'ADT'
views.utilization_event: SELECT p.patient_id, v.visit_source_value AS kind, v.visit_start_date AS event_date, v.visit_end_date AS end_date, CASE v.end_date_confirmed WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS discharge_known, s.care_site_source_value AS organization_id FROM main.visit_occurrence v JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) LEFT JOIN main.care_site s USING (care_site_id) WHERE v.feed = 'UTILIZATION'
views.fill: SELECT d.drug_exposure_id AS fill_id, p.patient_id, d.drug_exposure_start_date AS fill_date, d.days_supply, d.drug_source_value AS drug_name, CASE r.drug_class_name WHEN 'GLP-1 receptor agonist' THEN 'glp1_agonist' WHEN 'SGLT2 inhibitor' THEN 'sglt2_inhibitor' WHEN 'ACE inhibitor' THEN 'ace_inhibitor' WHEN 'Angiotensin receptor blocker' THEN 'arb' WHEN 'Mineralocorticoid antagonist' THEN 'mra' WHEN 'Long-acting beta agonist' THEN 'laba' WHEN 'Long-acting muscarinic antagonist' THEN 'lama' WHEN 'Beta blocker (heart failure evidence-based)' THEN 'hf_evidence_based_beta_blocker' WHEN 'HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin)' THEN 'statin' ELSE lower(replace(r.drug_class_name, ' ', '_')) END AS drug_class FROM main.drug_exposure d JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) LEFT JOIN main.drug_class_ref r USING (drug_class_id)
views.measurement: SELECT m.measurement_id AS record_id, p.patient_id, CASE l.lab_name WHEN 'Hemoglobin A1c' THEN 'hba1c' WHEN 'LDL cholesterol' THEN 'ldl' WHEN 'HDL cholesterol' THEN 'hdl' WHEN 'Estimated GFR' THEN 'egfr' WHEN 'Systolic blood pressure' THEN 'systolic_bp' WHEN 'Diastolic blood pressure' THEN 'diastolic_bp' WHEN 'NT-proBNP' THEN 'nt_probnp' WHEN 'Urine albumin/creatinine ratio' THEN 'uacr' WHEN 'Blood urea nitrogen' THEN 'bun' WHEN 'White blood cell count' THEN 'wbc' WHEN 'Oxygen saturation' THEN 'spo2' WHEN 'PHQ-9 score' THEN 'phq9' WHEN 'Thyroid stimulating hormone' THEN 'tsh' WHEN 'GFR (not normalized)' THEN 'gfr_unnormalized' ELSE lower(replace(l.lab_name, ' ', '_')) END AS concept, m.measurement_source_value AS name, m.measurement_date AS event_date, m.value_as_number AS value_canonical, m.unit_source_value AS unit_canonical FROM main.measurement m JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) LEFT JOIN main.lab_test_ref l USING (lab_code)
views.condition: SELECT c.condition_occurrence_id AS record_id, p.patient_id, lower(replace(c.condition_group, ' ', '_')) AS concept, c.condition_group AS label, c.condition_source_value AS icd10, c.condition_start_date AS event_date, s.care_site_source_value AS organization_id FROM main.condition_occurrence c JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) LEFT JOIN main.care_site s USING (care_site_id)
views.member_month: SELECT p.patient_id, substr(CAST(e.elig_month AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(e.elig_month AS TEXT), 5, 2) AS month, e.payer_source_value AS payer_id, CASE e.lob_code WHEN 'COM' THEN 'commercial' WHEN 'MCD' THEN 'medicaid' WHEN 'MCR' THEN 'medicare' WHEN 'DUAL' THEN 'dual' WHEN 'MGAP' THEN 'medigap' WHEN 'COB2' THEN 'cob_secondary' END AS line_of_business, e.attributed_practice_code AS attribution_practice_id FROM main.eligibility_month e JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id)
views.payer_claim: SELECT c.claim_id AS payer_claim_id, p.patient_id, CASE c.lob_code WHEN 'COM' THEN 'commercial' WHEN 'MCD' THEN 'medicaid' WHEN 'MCR' THEN 'medicare' WHEN 'DUAL' THEN 'dual' WHEN 'MGAP' THEN 'medigap' WHEN 'COB2' THEN 'cob_secondary' END AS line_of_business, CASE c.bill_form WHEN 'UB-04' THEN 'institutional' WHEN 'CMS-1500' THEN 'professional' END AS claim_type, c.service_start_date AS service_from, c.service_end_date AS service_to, CAST(ROUND(c.paid_amount * 100) AS INTEGER) AS paid_cents, CASE c.reportable WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS counts_in_metrics FROM main.medical_claim c JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id)
views.appointment: SELECT a.appt_id AS appointment_id, p.patient_id, a.appt_date AS scheduled_date, a.booked_date, CASE a.status_code WHEN 'CMP' THEN 'fulfilled' WHEN 'ATT' THEN 'attended' WHEN 'ARR' THEN 'arrived' WHEN 'BKD' THEN 'booked' WHEN 'CXL' THEN 'cancelled' WHEN 'NOS' THEN 'no_show' WHEN 'RSC' THEN 'rescheduled' WHEN 'UNK' THEN 'unassigned_requires_review' END AS final_status, s.care_site_source_value AS organization_id FROM main.appointment_schedule a JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) LEFT JOIN main.care_site s USING (care_site_id)
views.social_need: SELECT p.patient_id, lower(substr(o.observation_source_value, 6)) AS need, CASE o.value_as_string WHEN 'Positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS positive, o.instrument, o.observation_date AS event_date FROM main.observation o JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) WHERE o.observation_source_value LIKE 'SDOH-%'
views.death: SELECT p.patient_id, d.death_date FROM main.death d JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id)
views.wellness_visit: SELECT p.patient_id, o.procedure_date AS event_date, CASE WHEN o.procedure_source_value IN ('G0438', 'G0439') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS awv, CASE WHEN o.procedure_source_value IN ('G0438', 'G0439') THEN o.procedure_source_value END AS hcpcs_code FROM main.procedure_occurrence o JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) WHERE o.procedure_source_value IN ('G0438', 'G0439', 'PREVENTIVE-VISIT')
views.cancer_screening: SELECT p.patient_id, CASE o.procedure_source_value WHEN '77067' THEN 'bilateral_screening_mammography' WHEN '82274' THEN 'FIT' END AS test, o.procedure_date AS event_date FROM main.procedure_occurrence o JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id) WHERE o.procedure_source_value IN ('77067', '82274')
views.immunization: SELECT i.immunization_id AS record_id, p.patient_id, i.admin_date AS event_date, i.cvx_code AS cvx, i.billing_code AS code, i.product_name AS product, CASE WHEN i.cvx_code IN ('140', '168') OR i.billing_code IN ('90656', 'G0008', '90662') THEN 'influenza' WHEN i.cvx_code = '197' THEN 'influenza high-dose' WHEN i.cvx_code = '309' THEN 'COVID-19 2025-26' WHEN i.cvx_code = '115' THEN 'Tdap' WHEN i.cvx_code = '216' THEN 'pneumococcal conjugate PCV20' WHEN i.cvx_code = '20' THEN 'DTaP' WHEN i.cvx_code = '48' THEN 'Hib' WHEN i.cvx_code = '187' THEN 'zoster recombinant' WHEN i.cvx_code = '10' THEN 'IPV' WHEN i.cvx_code = '165' THEN 'HPV9' WHEN i.cvx_code = '21' THEN 'varicella' WHEN i.cvx_code = '08' THEN 'hepatitis B pediatric' WHEN i.cvx_code = '03' THEN 'MMR' WHEN i.cvx_code = '114' THEN 'meningococcal ACWY' END AS vaccine FROM main.immunization i JOIN (SELECT person_id, person_source_value AS patient_id FROM main.person) p USING (person_id)
views.measurement_latest: SELECT patient_id, concept, event_date, value_canonical, unit_canonical, record_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id, concept ORDER BY event_date DESC, record_id DESC) AS k FROM measurement WHERE concept IS NOT NULL AND value_canonical IS NOT NULL) WHERE k = 1
